app.description: Manages mods from Modrinth and CurseForge

cmd.help.usage.long:
Help provides help for any command in the application.
Simply type {appName} help [command] for more information.
cmd.add.short: Add a mod from CurseForge or Modrinth
cmd.remove.confirm.question: Remove these mods?
cmd.remove.summary.incomplete_hint: Fix the reason and rerun mmm remove.
cmd.remove.cancelled: Remove canceled. No changes were made.
cmd.lock_sync.header.detail: The following mods are in the lockfile, but not in the config:
cmd.lock_sync.prompt: What would you like to do?
cmd.lock_sync.option.add: Add the mods to the config
cmd.lock_sync.option.ignore: Ignore the mods (add to .mmmignore and remove lock entries)
cmd.lock_sync.result.add: All the missing mods have been added to the config.
cmd.lock_sync.result.delete: All the missing mods have been removed from disk and the lockfile.
cmd.lock_sync.result.ignore: All the missing mods have been ignored and removed from the lockfile.
cmd.lock_sync.error.policy_multiple: Choose only one lockfile sync policy flag.
cmd.lock_sync.error.invalid_filename_loc: Lock file entry for {name} has an unsafe filename ({file}). Edit modlist-lock.json to use a .jar filename in your mods folder, then rerun.
cmd.remove.error.failed_hint: Fix the error and rerun mmm remove.
cmd.remove.error.confirm_required: Non-interactive terminal detected. Remove requires confirmation.
cmd.add.flag.version: The version to add. Use the Modrinth version number or the exact CurseForge filename
cmd.add.flag.allow_version_fallback: Try lower Minecraft patch versions when no compatible file is found
cmd.add.prompt.modify_search: Would you like to modify your search?
cmd.add.error.not_found: {platform} doesn't have a project for id {id}.
cmd.add.error.not_found_hint: Verify the id on the platform and try again.
cmd.add.error.no_compatible: No file found for {loader} and Minecraft {gameVersion}.
cmd.add.error.download_failed_retries: We retried {count} times but could not complete the download.
cmd.add.error.download_failed_platform: It is possible that {platform} is experiencing issues.
cmd.add.error.download_failed_network: Check {platform} and your network and try again later.
cmd.add.error.failed_hint: Fix the error and rerun mmm add.
cmd.mods.error.missing_hash_remote: Unable to verify {name} because the platform did not provide a download hash. Please retry or choose a different version.
cmd.add.error.hash_mismatch: Downloaded file for {name} did not match the expected hash. Check your connection and retry. If it keeps happening, delete the file and run the command again.
cmd.mods.error.symlink_outside_mods: Refusing to write {name} because the resolved path ({path}) is outside your mods folder ({root}). Move the file into your mods folder or update your symlink.
cmd.add.error.invalid_filename_remote: The platform returned an unsafe filename for {name} ({file}). Please choose a different version or report the issue to the platform.
cmd.add.error.invalid_filename_lock: Lock file entry for {name} has an unsafe filename ({file}). Edit modlist-lock.json to use a .jar filename in your mods folder, then run mmm add again.
cmd.minecraft.version.unavailable: Could not verify the Minecraft version. Check your connection and try again.
cmd.minecraft.version.invalid: That Minecraft version does not exist
cmd.minecraft.version.latest_unavailable: Could not resolve latest, enter an explicit version
cmd.minecraft.version.question: What exact Minecraft version are you using? (eg: 1.18.2, 1.19, 1.19.1)
cmd.init.prompt.loader.question: Which loader would you like to use?
cmd.init.prompt.mods-folder.question: Which folder should MMM download mods into?
cmd.init.prompt.release-types.question: Which types of releases would you like to consider to download?
cmd.init.usage.loader:
Which loader do you want to use?
Possible options: {loaders}
cmd.init.usage.mods-folder: Where is your mods folder? (absolute path or relative to the config file directory)
cmd.init.usage.release-types:
Which types of releases would you like to consider to download? (comma-separated list)
Possible options: {releaseTypes}
cmd.init.flag.force: Overwrite the existing configuration file without prompting
cmd.init.prompt.config-path.question: Enter a new config path:
cmd.init.prompt.confirm-write.question: Write configuration now?
cmd.init.prompt.option.yes.label: yes
cmd.init.prompt.option.no.label: no
cmd.init.success: Created new configuration for {loader} and Minecraft {gameVersion} at {configPath}
cmd.init.success.next_steps: Run mmm add <platform> <id> to add your first mod.
cmd.init.error.mods-folder.not-directory: mods folder is not a directory: {path}
cmd.init.error.game-version.latest-unava: could not determine latest minecraft version; provide -g/--game-version

Run mmm init interactively or provide --loader and --game-version.
cmd.init.error.unattended.config_exists_: Rerun with --force to overwrite, use --config to choose a different path, or remove the existing file and try again.
cmd.minecraft.version.latest_unavailable: Could not resolve latest Minecraft version.
cmd.init.error.unattended.mods-folder-mi: Mods folder does not exist at {path}.
Create the folder or rerun with --mods-folder <path-to-existing-folder>.
cmd.init.error.unattended.mods-folder-no: Mods folder path is not a directory: {path}.
cmd.list.unmanaged.description: There are jar files in your mods folder that are not managed by MMM.
cmd.list.unmanaged.cta: Run mmm scan to adopt or resolve these files.
cmd.list.error.failed_hint: Fix the configuration and rerun mmm list.
cmd.config.confirm_init: Initialize a new configuration file now?
cmd.list.error.mods_folder: Could not show mod list: could not read mods folder at {modsFolder}: {reason}
cmd.list.error.mods_folder_hint: Check that the folder exists and that you have read access.
cmd.list.error.mods_folder_hint_secondar: If this path is wrong, update modsFolder in ./modlist.json.
cmd.list.error.mods_folder_partial: Could not finish mod list: could not read {path}: {reason}
cmd.list.error.mods_folder_partial_hint: Fix the folder access and rerun mmm list.
cmd.list.error.lock_missing: No lock file found at {lock_path}. Run {install_command} to create it.
cmd.list.error.invalid_filename_lock: Lock file entry for {name} has an unsafe filename ({file}). mmm will ignore it until you fix modlist-lock.json.
cmd.prune.summary.success_hint: Run mmm install to ensure your mods folder matches your configuration.
cmd.prune.summary.incomplete_hint: Please delete the files manually and rerun mmm prune --force.
cmd.prune.error.config_missing_hint: Run mmm init to create one.
cmd.prune.error.lock_missing_hint: Run mmm install to create it.
cmd.prune.error.unattended_refuse: Refusing to delete files in unattended mode without --force.
cmd.prune.error.failed_hint: Rerun mmm prune once the issue is resolved.
cmd.install.header.success: Ensuring all the configured mods are installed
cmd.install.summary.download_failed_hint: Check your network and rerun mmm install.
cmd.install.summary.partial: The install has completed but the mods with {errorIcon} have failed to download. Run mmm install again to retry the failed ones.
cmd.install.summary.write_failed_abort: Install has aborted because your {file} cannot be written.
cmd.install.summary.write_failed_hint: Fix the file permissions/issues and try mmm install again.
cmd.install.error.failed_hint: Fix the error and rerun mmm install.
cmd.install.unsure.hash_mismatch: {name} has a different version locally than what is in the lockfile
cmd.install.unsure.lock_missing: {name} has a local file that isn't in the lockfile.
cmd.install.error.unresolved: Please fix the unresolved issues above manually or by running mmm scan, then try again.
cmd.install.error.missing_hash_lock: Unable to verify {name} because the expected download hash is missing from your lock file. Please check your lock file and try again.
cmd.install.error.hash_mismatch: Downloaded file for {name} did not match the expected hash. Check your connection and retry. If it keeps happening, delete the file and run mmm install again.
cmd.install.error.invalid_filename_lock: Skipping {name} because the lock file contains an unsafe filename ({file}). Edit modlist-lock.json to use a .jar filename in your mods folder, then run mmm install again.
cmd.install.error.invalid_filename_remot: Skipping {name} because the platform returned an unsafe filename ({file}). Please choose a different version or report the issue to the platform.
cmd.install.download.hash_mismatch: {name} has hash mismatch, downloading from source
cmd.install.error.mod_not_found: {name}({id}) cannot be found on {platform} anymore. Was the mod revoked?
cmd.install.error.no_file: {platform} doesn't serve the required file for {name}({id}) anymore. Please update it.
cmd.scan.flag.prefer: Preferred platform for lookups (modrinth or curseforge)
cmd.scan.flag.add: Add discovered mods to the config and lock files
cmd.scan.all_managed: All of your mods are managed by mmm.
cmd.scan.section.unknown_note: no match on modrinth or curseforge
cmd.scan.prompt.add: Add recognized mods to your configuration?
cmd.scan.adoption.cancelled: Cancelled. Your configuration was not modified.
cmd.scan.persist_failed: Could not write an entry for {file}
cmd.update.error.mod_not_found: no longer found on {platform}. Was it removed?
cmd.update.error.no_file: {platform} doesn't serve the required file anymore. Please update it.
cmd.update.error.missing_hash_lock: expected download hash is missing from your lock file. Please check your lock file and try again.
cmd.update.error.missing_hash_remote: platform did not provide a download hash. Please retry or choose a different version.
cmd.update.error.hash_mismatch: downloaded update did not match the expected hash. Check your connection and retry. If it keeps happening, delete the file and run mmm update again.
cmd.update.error.symlink_outside_mods: refusing to write because the resolved path ({path}) is outside your mods folder ({root}). Move the file into your mods folder or update your symlink.
cmd.update.error.invalid_filename_lock: lock file contains an unsafe filename ({file}). Edit modlist-lock.json to use a .jar filename in your mods folder, then run mmm update again.
cmd.update.error.invalid_filename_remote: platform returned an unsafe filename ({file}). Please choose a different version or report the issue to the platform.
cmd.update.error.missing_lock_entry: mod doesn't seem to be installed. Please delete the lock file and the mods folder and try again.
cmd.update.error.locked_file_missing: expected file ({path}) doesn't exist. Please delete the lock file and the mods folder and try again.
cmd.update.error.unmanaged_found: Unmanaged mods were detected in your mods folder. Please remove them (or add them to your configuration) and try again.
cmd.update.header: Updating your mods to their newest versions:
cmd.update.summary.incomplete_hint: Fix the reasons and rerun `mmm update`.
cmd.update.error.install_failed_hint: Fix the reason and rerun `mmm update`.
cmd.update.error.write_lock: Could not write lock file at {path}.
cmd.update.error.write_hint: Fix the file permissions and rerun `mmm update`.
cmd.update.error.write_config: Could not write config file at {path}.
cmd.change.short: Change the configured Minecraft version and update the mods
cmd.change.flag.force: Force the change even if some mods lack support; skips unsupported mods during install
cmd.change.flag.keep_config: Keep incompatible mods in the config and remove their files (requires --force)
cmd.change.flag.prune_config: Remove incompatible mods from the config and remove their files (requires --force)
cmd.change.flag.disable_skipped: Keep incompatible mods in the config and disable their files (requires --force)
cmd.change.force.skipping_missing_suppor: Running with --force, continuing the change; mods without support for {version} will be skipped...
cmd.change.notice: Your current setup will not be modified until all downloads succeed.
cmd.change.force_policy.prompt: Choose what to do with the incompatible mods already present
cmd.change.force_policy.option.keep: Keep the mods in the config and remove the incompatible files
cmd.change.force_policy.option.prune: Remove the mods from the config and remove the incompatible files
cmd.change.force_policy.option.disable: Keep the mods in the config and disable the incompatible files (*.jar.disabled)
cmd.change.noop: Already targeting {version}. No changes were made.
cmd.change.error.download_failed: Downloads failed. No changes were made.
cmd.change.error.download_hint: Check your network and rerun `mmm change {version}`.
cmd.change.error.switch_failed: Switching failed. Attempted rollback. No changes were made.
cmd.change.error.latest_unavailable: Could not determine the latest Minecraft version. Please provide an explicit version instead.
cmd.change.error.invalid_version: {version} is not a valid Minecraft version.
cmd.change.error.failed_hint: Fix the error and rerun mmm change.
cmd.change.error.force_policy_choose: Choose exactly one policy flag under --force.
cmd.remove.error.invalid_filename_lock: Removed {name} from config, but skipped deleting the file because the lock file filename is unsafe ({file}). Please remove the file manually from your mods folder.
cmd.test.short: Test if mods have support for a target Minecraft version
cmd.test.summary.inconclusive_hint: Rerun later or run `mmm test --debug {version}` to capture a diagnostic log.
cmd.test.cannot_upgrade: You cannot upgrade to {version} just yet.
cmd.test.error.latest_unavailable_hint: Run `mmm test <version>` with an explicit version.
cmd.test.prompt.version.latest_question: Enter an explicit Minecraft version to test:
cmd.test.prompt.version.invalid_question: What exact Minecraft version are you trying to test against? (eg: 1.18.2, 1.19, 1.19.1)
